verdict.rationale: Bento's Events API (POST /batch/events) is documented to "track user activity, update profile fields, and trigger automations." Workflows start from a trigger, flows can be built from events, and first-party SDKs plus the CLI can track events from an app. Together these cover firing a product event that starts an automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an arbitrary custom-named event (beyond examples like $purchase) can be the workflow trigger and that the automation runs only for the identified subscriber, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
